outputs.exact_statement: Let $F_1,F_2$ be number fields, and let $E_i/F_i$ be possibly infinite solvably closed Galois extensions. Every continuous open homomorphism $$\alpha:\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(E_1/F_1)\longrightarrow\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(E_2/F_2)$$ is induced by a unique field embedding $j:E_2\hookrightarrow E_1$.

Every solvably closed algebraic extension $E$ of $\mathbb Q$ contains $\mathbb Q^s$. The field $\mathbb Q^s$ is solvably closed. For every number field $M\subset\mathbb Q^s$, the extension $\mathbb Q^s/M$ is the maximal prosolvable extension of $M$.

Let $E_i/F_i$ be solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields. Every isomorphism $\theta:\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(E_1/F_1)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(E_2/F_2)$ is induced by a unique field isomorphism $j:E_2\xrightarrow{\sim}E_1$, with $g j=j\theta(g)$ for all $g$.
The centralizer in $P$ of any open subgroup of $P$ is trivial.

Let $M$ be a number field, let $N\subset\mathbb Q^s$ be a number field, and let $\varphi:G_M\to P_N$ be open. Fix an odd prime $\ell$. Every prime $v\nmid\ell$ active at $\ell$ determines a unique prime $w\nmid\ell$ of $N$ for which, with suitable prolongations, $$\varphi(D_v)\subset D_w.$$ Moreover, $\varphi$ is injective on a pro-$\ell$ Sylow subgroup of $I_v$, and sends this subgroup into $I_w$. All but finitely many primes of $N$ arise from such active primes of $M$.

Let $E_i/F_i$ be solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields, and let $\alpha:\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(E_1/F_1)\to\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(E_2/F_2)$ be open. There exists an equivariant field embedding $E_2\hookrightarrow E_1$ if and only if $$\chi_{E_2/F_2}\circ\alpha=\chi_{E_1/F_1}
 \quad\text{in }\widehat{\mathbb Z}^{\times}.$$

Let $n,m\geq1$, let $E$ be a number field embedded in a finite extension $K/\mathbb Q_\ell$, and let $$u_i=(u_{i1},\ldots,u_{in})\in(E^\times)^n,
 \qquad 1\leq i\leq m,$$ have algebraic-integer coordinates that are units in $K$. Suppose that for every $a=(a_1,\ldots,a_m)\in\mathbb Z^m\setminus\{0\}$, the coordinates of $u^a:=\prod_{i=1}^m u_i^{a_i}$ are multiplicatively independent modulo roots of unity. If $m>n(n-1)$, then $$\operatorname{span}_K\{\log u_1,\ldots,\log u_m\}=K^n.$$

Let $M$ be a number field, let $\ell$ be a rational prime, and let $x\in X_{\ell}(M)$.*

1.  *If $x(\mathop{\mathrm{Fr}}_v)=0$ at infinitely many primes $v\nmid\ell$ of absolute residue degree one, then $x=0$.*

2.  *Suppose that $M/\mathbb Q$ is Galois, and fix $\delta\in\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(M/\mathbb Q)$. If $x(\mathop{\mathrm{Fr}}_v)=0$ at infinitely many primes $v\nmid\ell$ lying over rational primes unramified in $M$ whose Frobenius element at $v$ in $\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(M/\mathbb Q)$ is $\delta$, then $E_{\langle\delta\rangle}x=0$.*

3.  *If $\mathop{\mathrm{cor}}_{M/\mathbb Q}x\ne0$, then $x(\mathop{\mathrm{Fr}}_v)=0$ at only finitely many primes $v\nmid\ell$, with no restriction on their residue degrees.

Let $M/\mathbb Q$ be a finite, totally imaginary Galois extension, put $R=\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(M/\mathbb Q)$, and let $c\in R$ be a complex conjugation. For every rational prime $\ell$, there are $R$-equivariant embeddings $$\label{eq:signed-representation}
 W_M:=\mathop{\mathrm{Ind}}_{\langle c\rangle}^{R}(\mathrm{sign})
 \lhook\joinrel\longrightarrow X_{\ell}(M)
 \lhook\joinrel\longrightarrow\mathbb Q_\ell[R],$$ where $\mathrm{sign}(c)=-1$. In particular, the action of $R$ on $X_{\ell}(M)$ is faithful.
There is a unique continuous open homomorphism $$\beta:T\longrightarrow P$$ whose restriction to $U$ is $\alpha_0|_U$.

Fix an odd prime $\ell$, a finite quotient $R_0$ of $P$, and $\gamma_0\in R_0$. There are a quotient $$P\twoheadrightarrow R=\mathop{\mathrm{Gal}}(L/\mathbb Q)\twoheadrightarrow R_0$$ and a lift $\gamma\in R$ of $\gamma_0$ with the following property. There are infinitely many $\ell$-active primes $v$ of $k$, over distinct rational primes $p\ne\ell$, for which compatible prolongations can be chosen so that:*

1.  *the corresponding target rational prime $q\ne\ell$ is unramified in $L$, and the target prolongation restricts to a prime $w'$ of $L$ whose Frobenius in $R$ is $\gamma$;*

2.  *the image in $R$ of an arithmetic Frobenius lift at $v$ generates $\langle\gamma\rangle$.
For all but finitely many primes $w$ of $B$ above rational primes split in $B$, the set $\mathcal V_w$ is finite.

For every $\ell\in\mathcal L$, $$\#\{w\in\mathcal M_\ell:w\nmid\ell\}\le 2[K:\mathbb Q],
 \qquad
 \#\mathcal M_\ell\le 2[K:\mathbb Q]+2.$$

Let $m,d\ge1$, let $q_1,\ldots,q_n$ be distinct rational primes, and for each $j$ let $\mathcal P_j$ be a finite set of rational primes not containing $q_j$. Given any finite set of rational primes to avoid, there are infinitely many odd primes $\ell\equiv1\pmod m$ outside that set and all the displayed prime sets such that $$p^f\bmod\ell\notin\langle q_j\bmod\ell\rangle
 \quad
 (1\le j\le n,\ p\in\mathcal P_j,\ 1\le f\le d).$$ The sets $\mathcal P_j$ may overlap, and may contain $q_i$ for $i\ne j$.

For all but finitely many primes $w$ of $B$ above rational primes $q$ split in $B$, there exist a prime $v$ of $K$ above the same $q$ and an auxiliary prime $\ell\in\mathcal L$ for which $(v,w)$ is an active pair for $\beta_B$.
There is an element $a\in P$ such that $\beta=\mathop{\mathrm{Ad}}(a)\circ\sigma$ on $T$.
Let $F$ be a number field in $\overline{\mathbb Q}$. Every continuous open homomorphism $\varphi:G_F\to P$ is conjugate in $P$ to ordinary restriction.
